prompt: Write a casual text message to a friend asking if they want to grab a coffee later today.
expected: Very casual Swedish with du-address, informal greeting (Tja/Hej), optional light English mix, no God dag and no polite ni.
actual: Tja! Lust att ta en kaffe sen? Hade varit nice!

prompt: Reply to an email from a colleague who just sent the report, confirming you received it and that it looks pretty good.

actual: Tack! Fick rapporten, den ser helt okej ut. Grymt jobbat typ.

prompt: Translate this to casual Swedish for a close friend: That meeting was extremely bad and I am so tired of it.
